summary: Seven contrast pairs the chat components render and the audit did not know about: danger-fg on elevated as TEXT (a failed lane's and a failed task's reason), link-hover on accent-subtle-hover and muted on accent-subtle (Chat Sources' pressed marker and cited row), warning-fg on base (Chat Progress's failed-run receipt), and accent-legible on elevated and on bg-hover plus success-fg on bg-hover (the matrix and check on lanes, cards, the dock and a hovered task header). All clear their floors in theme zero with no role nudged — the tightest is accent-legible on bg-hover at 3.07:1 in light.
